subject.title: feat(android): add cron job management controls

question: Should this PR keep the new dedicated Android Cron Management Proof workflow, fold the cron proof into existing Android validation, or remove the workflow from this feature PR?
rationale: The PR adds permanent GitHub Actions automation with branch-scoped triggers and manual target_ref dispatch, which is an ownership and maintenance choice that code inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Android Validation
options.body: Move the cron proof into the existing Android CI/proof pattern so the feature is validated without adding a one-off branch-scoped workflow to main.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Workflow
options.body: Accept the new workflow as a maintained Android cron proof lane and own its branch/manual-dispatch semantics after merge.

options.title: Remove Workflow From This PR
options.body: Land the app changes only after external proof is attached, leaving durable proof automation for a separate maintainer-owned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Existing Android Validation
recommendation.body: Move the cron proof into the existing Android CI/proof pattern so the feature is validated without adding a one-off branch-scoped workflow to main.
